description: The SHURA Energy Transition Center, an Istanbul think tank, publishes a database of Turkish energy sector data as charts on its website. The database page read on 2026-09-28 says it presents realised data since 2016 for all stakeholders and groups the charts as energy imports and exports, total energy consumption by sector, the energy intensity index, energy sector and total greenhouse gas emissions, installed generation capacity, total electricity generation, gross electricity demand, the market clearing price, the number of power plants, instantaneous peak demand, renewable capacity allocated through YEKA auctions and commissioned since 2017, and the status of capacity allocated in wind auctions from 2011 to 2019, with comparisons by year, sector and source. Coverage is Turkey. Access is free on the web; no licence is stated, and whether chart data can be downloaded was not checked. Caveats: the values are compiled from official sources that the page does not name, so they must be checked against those sources. It supports capacity planning of the Turkish power system, such as comparing auctioned and commissioned renewables against peak demand. No related SHURA record is catalogued.
